audience: retail store owners and managers who run stock and sales in Lightspeed Retail (R-Series)

useCases.title: Find items that are low on stock
useCases.text: The AI reads quantity on hand, sellable stock, backorder and reorder point per item and shop. It lists the items below their reorder point in a store.

useCases.title: Sum up sales for a day or period
useCases.text: The AI lists completed sales in a date range, by shop or employee, and adds up totals and tax. With line items it shows what sold.

useCases.title: Track purchase orders from vendors
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase orders with ordered, arrival and received dates and shows which are not complete. It reads the order lines to compare quantities ordered and received.

useCases.title: Look up or add a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches customers by name, company or email and reads emails, phones, addresses and notes. You can also add a new customer with an email and phone.

useCases.title: Correct item details and stock counts
useCases.text: The AI changes an item's description, default cost, SKUs or category, and sets the quantity on hand for one item in one shop. Good for fixing a few items.
